migrations.description: Create persistent versioned Stage 3 C&C session and trace architecture while preserving legacy data
migrations.verify_sql: SELECT (to_regclass('public.activity_sessions') IS NOT NULL AND to_regclass('public.response_traces') IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name='activities' AND column_name='config') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_indexes WHERE tablename='activity_sessions' AND indexname='uq_candc_one_open_session_per_activity'));

migrations.description: Configure inactive canonical B1141 C&C instances CC01-CC03 with approved Stage 4 content
migrations.verify_sql: SELECT (COUNT(*) = 3 AND COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE active) = 0 AND COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE model <> 'categorise_compare' OR config IS NULL OR schema_version <> 1) = 0) FROM activities WHERE id IN ('b1141-w1-language-and-assumptions-candc','b1141-w2-us-them','b1141-w2-does-this-change-the-system');

migrations.description: Configure inactive canonical B1141 C&C instances CC04-CC07 with approved Stage 4 content
migrations.verify_sql: SELECT ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM activities WHERE model='categorise_compare') = 7 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM activities WHERE model='categorise_compare' AND active) = 0 AND COUNT(*) = 4 AND COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE model <> 'categorise_compare' OR config IS NULL OR schema_version <> 1) = 0) FROM activities WHERE id IN ('b1141-w3-political-or-non-political-candc','b1141-w4-design-an-inclusive-sport','b1141-w8-four-technological-interventions','b1141-w9-the-comparison');

migrations.description: Apply approved post-configuration learner-facing wording revisions while preserving Stage 3 mechanics and inactive status
migrations.verify_sql: SELECT ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM activities WHERE model='categorise_compare') = 7 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM activities WHERE model='categorise_compare' AND active) = 0 AND (SELECT config #>> '{items,1,optional_context,target_or_subject}' FROM activities WHERE id='b1141-w1-language-and-assumptions-candc') = 'a white winger' AND (SELECT config #>> '{categories,2,label}' FROM activities WHERE id='b1141-w2-us-them') = 'Both' AND (SELECT config #>> '{categories,2,label}' FROM activities WHERE id='b1141-w3-political-or-non-political-candc') = 'Contested' AND (SELECT config #>> '{categories,1,label}' FROM activities WHERE id='b1141-w4-design-an-inclusive-sport') = 'Familiar arrangement' AND (SELECT title FROM activities WHERE id='b1141-w8-four-technological-interventions') = 'What Counts as an Advantage?' AND (SELECT config #>> '{items,5,content}' FROM activities WHERE id='b1141-w9-the-comparison') = 'One tournament was extraordinarily geographically concentrated and the other extraordinarily geographically dispersed.');

migrations.description: Revise CC01 as the sequential mobile-first reference activity while preserving existing session snapshots and activation state
migrations.verify_sql: SELECT ((SELECT jsonb_array_length(config->'items') FROM activities WHERE id='b1141-w1-language-and-assumptions-candc') = 7 AND (SELECT config #>> '{items,0,id}' FROM activities WHERE id='b1141-w1-language-and-assumptions-candc') = 'aggressive_woman' AND (SELECT config #>> '{items,1,id}' FROM activities WHERE id='b1141-w1-language-and-assumptions-candc') = 'natural_black_winger' AND (SELECT config #>> '{items,5,id}' FROM activities WHERE id='b1141-w1-language-and-assumptions-candc') = 'worked_white_winger' AND (SELECT config #>> '{classification,prompt}' FROM activities WHERE id='b1141-w1-language-and-assumptions-candc') = 'What social assumption, if any, might sit behind this wording?');

migrations.description: Make CC01 Setting and About wording read as logically linked contextual statements while preserving session snapshots
migrations.verify_sql: SELECT ((SELECT config #>> '{items,0,optional_context,setting}' FROM activities WHERE id='b1141-w1-language-and-assumptions-candc') = 'A coach is meeting with the other coaches in the team.' AND (SELECT config #>> '{items,0,optional_context,target_or_subject}' FROM activities WHERE id='b1141-w1-language-and-assumptions-candc') = 'They are discussing one of the women players.' AND (SELECT config #>> '{items,1,optional_context,setting}' FROM activities WHERE id='b1141-w1-language-and-assumptions-candc') = (SELECT config #>> '{items,5,optional_context,setting}' FROM activities WHERE id='b1141-w1-language-and-assumptions-candc') AND (SELECT config #>> '{items,0,optional_context,setting}' FROM activities WHERE id='b1141-w1-language-and-assumptions-candc') = (SELECT config #>> '{items,6,optional_context,setting}' FROM activities WHERE id='b1141-w1-language-and-assumptions-candc'));
